lines.text: Sam. Sameh. Look at me. Two laps. I did twenty-six years of quarterly closes. I can do two laps.
That's your line? That's the line you're taking into that corner? Fine.
I went to China by myself, Sam. The Wall is long. This track is not.
You know what they wrote on my retirement cake? J, U, D, I. I still drove home fine.
Excuse me. Young lady coming through.
Enjoy it. Every Tuesday ends, Sam.
Oh, that's cute. The spreadsheet's still not done, by the way.
Last lap. Hear that? That's the music changing. That's for me.
I was Chief Operating Officer of a company that makes hips. I know exactly how to take a corner.
Hey! This is a lease!
Oops. Did I do that? I did that.
That one's for the spreadsheet.
Twenty-six years of board meetings, Sam. I know how to throw an elbow.
You're in my lane. All the lanes are my lane.
Titanium hip, Sam. I don't feel a thing.
Young lady coming through. Again.
Sign the thing! Put your address on it!
What was that? Did you just jump? Where did you learn that?
Oh no. Oh no no no no!
My arm! Sam! That's my good arm! Go get it!
It's over there, Sam. Follow the sparkle.
Any day now. I'm bleeding sequins over here.
There's tape in the kart. Gray tape. Fixes everything.
That's it. Bring it here. Now tape it. Tighter. Tighter!
Good as new. Titanium hip, duct-tape arm. Out of my way.
Ha ha ha ha ha!
I won. Twenty-six years, Sam. Now go sign the thing. And put your address on it this time.
